items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Well, when they had a drummer with him, a boy named Johnny Washington which was also out of Buffalo.

ctx.x: Because that band broke up in Buffalo.

Yeah, yeah. I think Stuff had His own little trio or quartet then at the time I met him. Well, when they had a drummer with him, a boy named Johnny Washington which was also out of Buffalo. So they came to New York and they were on 52nd Street, and I think Johnny Washington had enough of the road, he wanted to come back home to

Buffalo and so Stuff asked me would I like to join the band, so I said yes, and then's when I joined the band, out of Willie Bryant's band, I would join Stuff at the Onyx Club on 52nd Street. There I stayed, oh goodness, I was with Stuff quite a while till I joined Cab Calloway. And then oh goodness, all during that time that I was with Stuff, is when I started to do records with everybody, you know like with Bunny Berigan, Dick McDonna and Carl Kriss..
